assumptions.statement: The submitted site boundary and three key-area polygons are provisional, inferred from public reference data, and must not be used as official redlines or precise-area bases. Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: Current site_area_sqm, ratios, drawing labels and phase areas are concept-model outputs with low confidence for boundary-dependent values. When official geometry is supplied, rerun spatial review and regenerate metrics, figures, drawings and phase calculations before any statutory or investment decision.
